name: Model independence and provenance
summary: Make atlas-owned BPMN authoring the future default while preserving versioned Zeebe import/reload compatibility, replacing Camunda-specific DMN authoring only with test evidence, and completing third-party provenance and licence gates.
next_action: Review the initial provenance evidence and proposed native-dialect ADR; verify upstream component licences and legacy model compatibility before touching runtime or authoring code.
